question: Which water body is the world's third largest ocean spread over an area of 70,560,000 km² on the earth's surface?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indian ocean __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **It is the only ocean with an asymmetric and, in the north, semiannually reversing surface circulation.**
 
• It has no separate source of bottom water that** is the Indian Ocean's bottom water originates outside its boundaries and has two sources of highly saline water (the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea**
 
• It is **bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west and Australia to the east.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The second-largest ocean on Earth, the Atlantic **drives our weather patterns, including hurricanes, and is home to many species from sea turtles to dolphins.**

 
 
• For centuries the Atlantic Ocean has been a key avenue of trade and travel.
 
 
 
• **The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth.**
 
 
• It spans 60 million square miles from California to China, and in certain regions extends tens of thousands of feet below the surface of the water
 
 
 
• The **Southern Ocean is known for its uniqueness in the diversity** of organisms.
 
 
• Cold adaptation and evolution in thermal isolation over tens of millions of years has resulted in an ecosystem that is unparallelled
